Product.description:
Bepanthen Antiseptic Cream is for the temporary relief of Nappy Rash and is also used for the treatment of cuts, scalds, stings and sunburn.

Bepanthen Antiseptic Cream has been formulated with an antiseptic, to help kill germs, making it suitable for use when you want to help protect damaged skin from infection.

Bepanthen Antiseptic Cream leaves a waterproof barrier that helps protect between nappy changes. It also helps to provide a moist healing environment so baby's bottom will be on the mend.

Features and benefits
Contains citrus bioflavonoids extract to boost its vitamin C action in the body. 
Buffered with mineral ascorbates making it gentle on the stomach. 
Contains a natural source of vitamin C, acerola.  
Contains no artificial sweeteners making it suitable for the whole family. 
Reduces the severity and duration of colds. 
Helps to support skin suppleness and elasticity via its role in collagen production. 
As a potent antioxidant it protects against free radical damage. 
Promotes wound healing. 
Maintains capillary health.

Additional information
The human body does not manufacture its own vitamin C and so it must be sourced from our diet. Stress of all kinds, including ill health and emotional stress, increases the excretion of vitamin C from the body and may increase the need for this vitamin. If dietary intake is low or an individual's need is particularly high, vitamin supplementation may be of benefit. 
Vitamin C is involved in hundreds of biological processes. It is important in immunity as it is involved in the function of white blood cells and antibodies. It is beneficial when dealing with the symptoms of the common cold. 
Vitamin C is involved in the manufacture of collagen, an important protein in the body. Collagen is a structural protein found in cartilage and tendons, and it helps to support blood vessels. Due to its role in collagen manufacture vitamin C is necessary for wound repair. 

Citrus bioflavonoids have been shown to support capillary function by reducing fragility of capillary walls and improving capillary permeability. 
Dosage
Adults – Take 1 g (1 level scoop using measuring scoop enclosed) a day with a meal, or as professionally prescribed. At the onset of cold symptoms the dose may be increased to 1 g 3 times a day. 
Children 4-12 years – Take 250 mg (1/4 level scoop) twice a day with meals, or as professionally prescribed.
Children 2 - 4 years – Take 250 mg (1/4 level scoop) a day with a meal, or as professionally prescribed.
Not to be used by children under 2 years of age without medical advice. 
Add powder to fruit juice or water. Note this product contains citrus bioflavonoids which do not dissolve. Stir vigorously to disperse. Always use a dry scoop and replace lid tightly.
 
Contraindications and cautions
Consult your healthcare professional before use if you have had renal calculi (kidney stones). Ascorbic acid may increase the risk of recurrence of calcium oxalate calculi. 
Always read the label. Use only as directed.  
If symptoms persist, see your healthcare professional.  
Active ingredients
Ascorbic acid 300 mg 
Calcium ascorbate 300 mg 
Sodium ascorbate 260 mg 
(Total Vitamin C 779 mg)
 
Citrus bioflavonoids extract 40 mg 
Rutin 40 mg 
Malpighia punicifolia (Acerola) extract equiv. to dry fruit 160 mg 
Hesperidin 20 mg 
Medicine interactions
Ascorbic acid may increase the absorption of aluminium. In kidney failure doses should be separated by at least 2 hours from doses of aluminium-containing preparations. 
Ascorbic acid may decrease the absorption and efficacy of propranolol. If taking propranolol, separate doses by at least two hours. 
Physical description
An off white to pale yellow free-flowing powder, with tangy citrus taste.

Benefiber is 100% Natural fibre that you can mix with almost anything. It is taste free, grit free and will never thicken so it won't alter the taste or texture of your foods or beverages.

Attributes

•Non-thickening powder
•Sugar-free
•Flavor-free
•Great for cooking
•Dissolves completely in beverages† and soft foods

Ingredient

Wheat dextrin

Gluten-free (less than 20 ppm gluten)


Supplement Facts
 
  Serving Size: 2 tsp (3.5g)  
       Amount Per
   Serving  %DV*  
  Calories   15    
  Sodium   0mg  0%  
  Total Carbohydrates  4g   1%  
  Dietary Fibre  3g   12%  
  Soluble Fibre  3g   †  
  Sugar   0g   †  
  *Percent Daily Values (DV) are based on a 2,000 calorie diet.
†Daily Value not established.

Directions

Stir 2 teaspoons of Benefiber into 4-8 oz of any beverage† or soft food (hot or cold). Stir well until dissolved.


Age   Servings
 
12 yrs. to adult  2 teaspoons 3 times daily  
6 to 11 yrs.   1 teaspoon 3 times daily  
Under 6 yrs.   Ask your doctor before use

Keep out of reach of children.
 If you are pregnant or nursing a baby, ask a health professional before use.

†Not recommended for carbonated beverages.

Dietary fibre comes from plant sources and is an important part of a healthy diet.

Types of Fibre

In general, there are two types of fibre: soluble and insoluble. Many plant foods contain some of both. There are some differences; for example, soluble fibres dissolve in water and insoluble fibres do not. Good sources of soluble fibre include oats, beans, dried peas, fruits, vegetables and legumes. Wheat bran, whole grain products and vegetables are good sources of insoluble fibre.

How Much Fibre Do I Need?

The American Dietetic Association recommends a healthy diet include 20-35 grams of fibre a day from plant foods, including both soluble and insoluble fibre. However, Americans only consume about half that amount. You should do your best to get the fibre you need from the foods you eat each day. Some foods do have more fibre than others:
•Beans, such as kidney, navy and pinto, have 4-8 grams
 in ½ cup
•Brown rice has 3 grams in 1 cup
•Fruits with skin, such as apples and pears, have 4 grams
•High fibre cereals can have as much as 10 grams of fibre
 per serving — check the label
•Green peas have 4 grams in ½ cup

Each serving of Benefiber Powder provides 3 grams of fibre and the powder is easily mixed into beverages† or soft foods. For example, try mixing Benefiber Powder into any of the following:
•Water
•Pudding
•Milk
•Cereal
•Coffee
•Yogurt
•Pasta sauce
•Gelatin

*Take along with a healthy diet.
This product is not intended to diagnose treat, cure or prevent any disease.

Bio‑Oil is a specialist skincare oil that helps improve the appearance of scars, stretch marks and uneven skin tone. It is also effective for aging and dehydrated skin. Bio‑Oil has won 126 skincare awards and has become the No.1 selling scar and stretch mark product in 14 countries since its global launch in 2002.

The Bio‑Oil formulation is a combination of plant extracts and vitamins suspended in an oil base. It contains the breakthrough ingredient PurCellin Oil™, which changes the formulation’s overall consistency, making it light and non-greasy. This ensures that the goodness contained in the vitamins and plant extracts is easily absorbed.
Bio‑Oil has undergone safety assessments in accordance with the Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on Cosmetic Products. The toxicological profile, chemical structure, level of inclusion and total level of daily exposure of each ingredient used has been assessed and deemed safe for use (including for use by pregnant women).
Bio‑Oil is a member of Beauty Without Cruelty International.

Bio‑Oil is manufactured in accordance with cGMP (current Good Manufacturing Practice) as stipulated by the World Health Organization. All ingredients are tested for adulteration and microbiological contamination prior to production and a sample from each batch manufactured is laboratory tested and then retained and monitored over a 5-year period.
All Bio‑Oil packaging is recyclable and all paper materials are certified to be in accordance with sustainable forest management practices.
No harmful emissions, hazardous waste or wastewater is generated in the production of Bio‑Oil.

Product.description:
Bio‑Oil is a specialist skincare oil that helps improve the appearance of scars, stretch marks and uneven skin tone. It is also effective for aging and dehydrated skin. Bio‑Oil has won 126 skincare awards and has become the No.1 selling scar and stretch mark product in 14 countries since its global launch in 2002.

The Bio‑Oil formulation is a combination of plant extracts and vitamins suspended in an oil base. It contains the breakthrough ingredient PurCellin Oil™, which changes the formulation’s overall consistency, making it light and non-greasy. This ensures that the goodness contained in the vitamins and plant extracts is easily absorbed.
Bio‑Oil has undergone safety assessments in accordance with the Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on Cosmetic Products. The toxicological profile, chemical structure, level of inclusion and total level of daily exposure of each ingredient used has been assessed and deemed safe for use (including for use by pregnant women).
Bio‑Oil is a member of Beauty Without Cruelty International.

All Bio‑Oil packaging is recyclable and all paper materials are certified to be in accordance with sustainable forest management practices.

Product.description:
Features and benefits

Small sized tablet for ease of swallowing
Suitable for use during pregnancy and lactation

Additional information
Magnesium aspartate is a bio-available form of magnesium.

Dosage
Adults- Take two to six tablets daily with meals, or as professionally prescribed.

Children (6-12 years) – Take one to three tablets daily with meals, or as professionally prescribed.

Under 6 years – As professionally prescribed.

Active ingredients
Magnesium aspartate dihydrate (Magnesium 37.4mg)  500 mg

Medicine interactions
Magnesium may decrease the absorption and efficacy of some medications. If taking tetracycline or quinolone antibiotics separate doses by at least 2 hours

Physical description
White round tablet

Features and benefits

Supports healthy immune function.
Traditionally used to relieve symptoms of mild upper respiratory tract infections such as colds and flu.
May shorten the duration and decrease the severity of cold symptoms.
May help decrease the incidence of colds.
Low dose supplement for long term use.

Additional information
Echinacea has been shown to stimulate the immune system and may reduce the duration of colds and minor infections of the respiratory tract. One of the ways that echinacea works in the immune system is by increasing the number of white blood cells. White blood cells are involved in defending the body against foreign micro-organisms. Echinacea also stimulates a group of immune system cells called phagocytes, which engulf and digest bacteria or other foreign bodies.
Betacarotene is a precursor to vitamin A. Vitamin A is essential for the maintenance of healthy mucous membranes including the lining of the stomach and lungs. Betacarotene is an antioxidant that reduces the risk of cellular damage caused by free radicals.
Vitamin C is important to immunity as it is involved in the function of white blood cells and antibodies. It is beneficial when dealing with the symptoms of the common cold. Vitamin E supports immune function by increasing antibody production and lymphocyte function. Lymphocytes are cells in the body which produce antibodies to attach to infected cells. Vitamin E supports immune function via its antioxidant action.
Zinc is a mineral that is essential to good health as it is found in every cell of the body and is involved in many enzyme reactions. Adequate levels of zinc are critical for the proper functioning of the immune system. Zinc inhibits the growth of many viruses, including the common cold viruses.
Vitamin B6 enhances immune responsiveness.

Dosage
Adults – Take 1 tablet 3 times a day with meals, or as professionally prescribed.
Children 2-12 years – Only as professionally prescribed. Not to be used by children under 2 years of age without medical advice.

Contraindications and cautions
Consult your healthcare professional before use if you have had renal calculi (kidney stones). Ascorbic acid may increase the risk of recurrence of calcium oxalate calculi.
May occasionally cause mild gastrointestinal symptoms.
Use with caution if you suffer from asthma or allergies
Always read the label. Use only as directed.
If symptoms persist, see your healthcare professional.

Active ingredients
Echinacea purpurea (Echinacea) extract equiv. to dry whole plant 500 mg
Betacarotene 3 mg
Vitamin B5 (Pantothenic acid from calcium pantothenate 28 mg)  25.7 mg
Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine hydrochloride) 13 mg
Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid) 250 mg
Vitamin E (d-alpha-tocopheryl acid succinate 41.3 mg) 50 IU
Zinc amino acid chelate (Zinc 1.3 mg) 6.5 mg

Medicine interactions
Zinc may decrease the absorption and efficacy of some medications. If taking tetracycline or quinolone antibiotics separate doses by at least 2 hours.

Physical description
A red-brown, oval shaped tablet with opaque coating.

Product.product_title: Blackmores Executive B Stress Formula Tab 175
Product.description:
Features and benefits

Helps you cope with stress.
Contains passionflower traditionally used to relieve nervous tension.
Helps the body convert food into energy.

Additional information
The human body has increased requirements for vitamins (especially the B group) during periods of increased stress. During stress, nutrients such as vitamin C and vitamin B5 are important for supporting adrenal function. Vitamin B5 has long been considered the "anti-stress" vitamin because of its central role in adrenal function and cellular metabolism.
Some of the B group vitamins, such as folic acid, inositol and vitamin B6, are involved in the manufacture and action of mood enhancing hormones such as serotonin.
The herb passionflower has traditionally been used for its sedative and anxiety relieving properties. Passionflower is indicated for restlessness and nervous tension.

Dosage
Adults – Take 1 tablet with breakfast and 1 tablet with lunch, or as professionally prescribed.
Children under 12 years – Only as professionally prescribed. Vitamin supplements should not replace a balanced diet.
Contraindications and cautions
Contains gluten.
If symptoms persist, see your healthcare professional.
If you are pregnant or breastfeeding consult your healthcare professional before use.

Active ingredients
Vitamin B1 (Thiamine hydrochloride) 75 mg
Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin) 10 mg
Nicotinamide 100 mg
Vitamin B5 (Pantothenic acid from calcium pantothenate 75mg)  68.7 mg
Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine hydrochloride) 25 mg
Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin) 30 µg
Vitamin H (Biotin) 20 µg
Calcium ascorbate 145 mg
Ascorbic acid (Total Vitamin C 250mg)  130 mg
Vitamin E (d-alpha-Tocopheryl acid succinate 41.3 mg) 50 IU
Magnesium phosphate 140 mg
Calcium phosphate 100 mg
Potassium phosphate monobasic 117.3 mg
Folic acid 150 µg
Avena sativa (Oats) extract equiv. to dry seed  250 mg
Passiflora incarnata (Passion flower) extract equiv. to dry herb 100 mg
Lecithin 50 mg
Choline bitartrate 25 mg
Inositol 25 mg

Medicine interactions
Consult your healthcare professional before use if taking, or think you may be taking, a diuretic (fluid tablet).
Magnesium and calcium may decrease absorption and efficacy of some medications. If taking tetracycline or quinolone antibiotics, bisphosphonates (osteoporosis drugs) or thyroid hormones, separate doses by at least 2 hours.
Folic acid may decrease the effectiveness of methotrexate in the treatment of leukaemia.

Physical description
A yellow/brown, mottled, large tablet. Film-coated dark brown.

Physical description

Features and benefits

No fishy aftertaste, developed without the use of artificial surfactants (polysorbates).
Vanilla-lemon flavouring masks any fishy odours.
Natural source of omega-3s.
Helps to reduce inflammation and joint swelling associated with arthritis.
Helps to support heart and cardiovascular health.
Helps to assist in the maintenance of normal eye and brain function.
Helps to decrease triglycerides (fat) in the blood of healthy people.
Mercury tested.

Additional information
Fish oil is a source of the omega-3 essential fatty acids. Essential fatty acids are incorporated into every cell membrane in the body, in the form of compounds called phospholipids. Cell membranes play the vital role of regulating what goes into, and what comes out of, each cell. The integrity and fluidity of the cell membrane is determined by the type of phospholipid that is available for the body to use. Cell membranes made up mainly of phospholipids derived from the essential polyunsaturated fatty acids are more fluid and function better than cell membranes made up of saturated fat or trans-fatty acids. A cell membrane working at optimal levels retains vital nutrients and electrolytes, has the ability to communicate with other cells and is responsive to hormones.
Omega-3 fatty acids are also important components of substances known as prostaglandins and leukotrienes. Prostaglandins and leukotrienes are important in immune function, smooth muscle function, platelet aggregation and inflammation. Fish oils have an anti-inflammatory action because prostaglandins and leukotrienes from omega-3 fatty acids have less inflammatory activity than prostaglandins and leukotrienes derived from other types of fatty acids.
Fish oils appear to alleviate the pain of rheumatoid arthritis due to the role of omega-3 fatty acids in suppression of the production of inflammatory compounds.
Fish oil inhibits triglyceride synthesis in the liver and so helps to lower fats (triglycerides) in the blood of healthy people, therefore supporting a healthy cardiovascular system.

Dosage
For arthritis:
Adults – Take up to 4 capsules 3 times a day with meals, or as professionally prescribed.
Children under 12 years – Only as professionally prescribed.
As an omega-3 supplement:
Adults – Take 2 capsules a day with a meal, or as professionally prescribed.
Children 6-12 years – Take 1 to 2 capsules a day (pierce and squeeze into milk, juice or cereal), or as professionally prescribed.
Children 2-6 years – Take 1 capsule a day (pierce and squeeze into milk, juice or cereal).

Contraindications and cautions
High doses of fish oil (10 or more capsules per day) may increase the risk of bleeding with blood-thinning medications and should not be taken in the week before surgery.
May occasionally cause mild reflux.

Features and benefits

Combined arthritis pain relief.
Results expected after 2-4 weeks.
No artificial surfactants to disguise fishy odours.
Helps to increase joint mobility and reduce joint stiffness.
Helps to reduce joint inflammation and swelling.

Additional information
Glucosamine and sulfate are natural components found in the cartilage matrix and synovial fluid. Glucosamine is a major building block of the substances that together with protein form the structural units in cartilage. These structural units, called aggrecans, are important for the elasticity, resilience and shock-absorbing properties of cartilage. Ageing decreases the body's ability to restore and manufacture normal cartilage. Supplementary glucosamine can be an important source of this vital component of cartilage as we age.
Osteoarthritis is characterized by joint degeneration and loss of cartilage. As we get older the ‘wear and tear' effects of use cause degenerative changes in the cartilage. The cartilage becomes more susceptible to breakdown and damage, which may result in the typical symptoms of osteoarthritis. These symptoms include decreased mobility, increased joint stiffness, inflammation and pain.
Glucosamine may help to provide relief from these symptoms, as well as helping to reduce cartilage wear and provide temporary relief of the pain associated with this condition.
Researchers found in a clinical trial that patients with osteoarthritis of the knees had a clinically significant improvement in pain and mobility after a period of four weeks using glucosamine sulphate 500 mg three times daily.
Fish oils are a source of omega-3 fatty acids. Omega-3 fatty acids are important for the production of substances known as prostaglandins and leukotrienes. Prostaglandins and leukotrienes are important in immune function, smooth muscle function, platelet aggregation and inflammation. Fish oils have an anti-inflammatory action because prostaglandins and leukotrienes from omega-3 fatty acids have less inflammatory activity than prostaglandins and leukotrienes derived from other types of fatty acids.
Fish oil helps to maintain and support a healthy heart and cardiovascular system. It can assist in the maintenance of normal eye and brain function, as well as decreasing fat (triglycerides) in the blood in healthy people. Fish oil inhibits triglyceride synthesis in the liver and so helps to lower fats (triglycerides) in blood, therefore supporting a healthy cardiovascular system.

Dosage
Adults – Take 1 capsule 3 times a day with meals, or as professionally prescribed.
Children under 12 years – Only as professionally prescribed.

Contraindications and cautions
This product is derived from crustacean shells. People who are allergic to seafood should exercise extreme caution.

Features and benefits

Convenient one a day dose
Effective for osteoarthritic pain relief
Helps reduce cartilage wear
Contains the most scientifically validated form of glucosamine; glucosamine sulfate sodium chloride complex
Results expected after 2-4 weeks

Additional information
Glucosamine and sulfate are natural components found in the cartilage matrix and synovial fluid.  Glucosamine is a major building block of the substances that together with protein form the structural units in cartilage. These structural units, called aggrecans, are important for the elasticity, resilience and shock-absorbing properties of cartilage. Ageing decreases the body’s ability to restore and manufacture normal cartilage. Supplementary glucosamine sulfate as glucosamine sulfate sodium chloride complex helps reduce cartilage wear, increase joint mobility and decrease joint stiffness in osteoarthritis.
Osteoarthritis is characterized by joint degeneration and loss of cartilage. As we get older the ‘wear and tear’ effects of use cause degenerative changes in the cartilage. The cartilage becomes more susceptible to breakdown and damage, which may result in the typical symptoms of osteoarthritis.  These symptoms include decreased mobility, increased joint stiffness and pain.
Glucosamine may help to provide relief from these symptoms, as well as helping to reduce cartilage wear and provide temporary relief of the pain associated with this condition.
Clinical trials have shown that 1500 mg glucosamine sulfate as sodium chloride complex significantly improves pain and functionality in osteoarthritis. Results show a decrease in pain of 20-41%, and improved functionality of 21-46%. In addition, glucosamine sulfate may have a long-term protective effect, acting to reduce cartilage wear. An eight-year study on 275 patients, published in 2008, found that supplementation with 1500 mg/day of glucosamine sulfate for at least one year reduced the risk of knee replacement to approximately half that of the placebo group. The same study also found in a sub-group analysis that patients who had previously taken glucosamine sulfate used significantly less medications & health resources for osteoarthritis symptoms.

Adults – Take 1 easy swallow tablet a day with a meal, or as professionally prescribed.
Children under 12 years – Only as professionally prescribed.

Glucosamine is derived from seafood. Not recommended for people with seafood allergies.

Features and benefits

Blackmores Detox Program includes:
An exfoliating mitt for your skin
A comprehensive detox by targeting five major organs
A 10 day commitment, making it easier to successfully complete the program
Free support from Blackmores naturopaths with tips, advice and motivation to help you stay on course and treat your body to a fresh start.  Call our free advisory service on 1800 803 760
For information and downloads to support your detox program visit detox.blackmores.com.au

Additional information

The Detox Program is based on the naturopathic belief that health problems may be caused by the digestive system not functioning efficiently.
The body has many complex ways of eliminating toxic wastes.  Without these we could not survive.  Put simply, the processes of digestion and elimination involve the following organs:
The stomach churns and mixes the food with gastric juices that break down food and kill bacteria.  The stomach then releases a small amount of food at a time into the small intestine.
The small intestine mixes broken down food with digestive juices and bile.  It then finishes the digestion of proteins, carbohydrates and fats.  The small intestine absorbs around 90% of all nutrients.
The large intestine (colon) absorbs water and vitamins and minerals and contains most of the gastrointestinal microflora.  The final part of the large intestine, the rectum, is like a rubbish bin and temporarily holds waste until it is ready to be emptied.  If waste matter is left in the ‘storage area’ for too long, too much water can be reabsorbed, resulting in constipation.
The liver has many functions, but one of the most important is to filter your blood.  It filters out toxic substances in the blood before it returns to general circulation.  It also produces bile, which helps break down fats in the intestines.
The skin is the largest organ of the body.  The sweat glands of the skin allow toxins to escape as we perspire.
Digestive Bitters contain bitter herbs which have traditionally been used to increase bile flow.  They stimulate the bitter taste receptors on the tongue, which in turn stimulate the upper digestive function (i.e. the stomach, liver and pancreas).  In the stomach gastric acid secretion is increased, which has traditionally been shown to be beneficial in indigestion.
Milk Thistle supports the liver and has an antioxidant and free radical scavenging action.  It supports the regeneration of liver cells and may help protect against potentially harmful substances.
Acidophilus Bifidus contains Lactobacillus acidophilus and Bifidobacterium animalis which are important beneficial bacteria, helping to stabilise and maintain healthy gut flora.
Colon Care is a laxative, prepared with fibre and herbs to assist the functioning of the colon.  It promotes elimination and rids the body of waste.
The calorie-controlled menu plan that can be downloaded at blackmores.com.au/detox is based on a level of 1434 calories (6000 kilojoules) per day.

Detoxifying is a unique experience for everyone.  Some people find they breeze through a detox program, while others don’t feel so good – at least initially.  While on this Detox Program you may experience various side effects depending on how your body reacts to, or eliminates toxins.
Symptoms might include:
Headaches: these are common when coffee is taken out of the diet.
Constipation:  this may occur in the initial stage of the program but it is nothing to worry about as the Program is designed to aid normal bowel function.  Remember to drink at least two litres of water a day and eat a high fibre diet to ensure regularity
Flatulence or bloating:  this is generally due to the change to a high fibre diet and will settle down as your body becomes accustomed to the Program
Tiredness: this may be due to cutting out stimulants such as sugar and coffee that give you a false lift. Toxin accumulation can also make you feel lethargic.

Features and benefits

Reduce joint swelling & inflammation in rheumatoid arthritis
Promote brain health
Support cognitive function with ageing
Promote heart health
Highly purified and rigorously tested for quality
Odourless, vanilla flavoured capsules

Mercury, dioxin, PCB tested

Additional information
The National Health and Medical Research Council recommends daily intakes of 610 mg for men and 430 mg for women of omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA + DPA) for health maintenance.

Heart health
Omega-3s may support heart health by the maintenance of the suppleness and elasticity of blood vessels, helping support blood flow and also by assisting the maintenance of triglycerides (fats) within the normal range in the blood of healthy people. Populations consuming at least 1-2 meals of fish per week have reduced deaths due to cardiovascular disease.

Brain, nervous system and eye health
EPA and DHA are important for the structure and function of cell membranes. Omega-3 fatty acids are particularly rich in the brain, nervous system and retina where they play an important role in development and function. They support a healthy mood and higher intakes of omega-3s are associated with less age-related mental decline.

Joint health
Omega-3 fatty acids have also demonstrated anti-inflammatory effects which may be due to decreased production of certain inflammatory compounds. At higher doses, omega-3 fatty acids are thought to help relieve the symptoms of rheumatoid arthritis (including helping reduce morning stiffness, pain and swelling. )

Adults:
As an omega-3 supplement – Take 1 capsule a day with food, or as professionally prescribed

For arthritis – Take 1 capsule 3 times a day with food, or as professionally prescribed

Children 6-12 years – Take 1 capsule a day (pierce and squeeze into milk, juice or cereal), or as professionally prescribed.

Children 2-6 years – Only as professionally prescribed.

If symptoms persist see your healthcare professional

Features and benefits

Provides iodine to promote healthy development of baby's brain, eyesight & hearing.
Provides a daily dose of 500 µg of folic acid that may reduce the risk of brain and/or spinal cord birth defects such as spina bifida and anencephaly if taken daily for 1 month prior to conception and during pregnancy.
Provides vitamin D3 to support calcium absorption to assist with healthy development of baby's bones.
Provides omega-3 essential fatty acids to promote healthy development of baby's brain & eyesight.
Provides overall nutritional support with 17 nutrients including 10 vitamins, 6 minerals, and omega-3 fatty acids.

Additional information
Blackmores Pregnancy and Breast-feeding Gold contains the following essential nutrients:
Iodine - is important for the normal functioning of the thyroid gland as it is an essential nutrient required for the synthesis of thyroid hormones. Thyroid hormones affect almost every cell in the body and regulate oxygen use, metabolic rate and cellular metabolism. Thyroid hormones are important for the normal development of the skeletal, muscular and nervous systems of children. Iodine plays an important role in the normal development of brain, eyesight and hearing.
Fish oil - is a source of omega-3 long chain fatty acids. One of the main long chain fatty acids found in breast milk and in fish oil is DHA. DHA is particularly important for the normal function of the brain and nerves, and for development of normal eyesight.
Folic acid - plays a role in DNA and RNA synthesis, and is therefore critical in cellular division. In order to divide properly cells need adequate folic acid. The development and growth of a foetus involves constant cell division, which can lead to an increase in the mother's demand for folate. Daily supplementation with folic acid for 1 month prior to conception and during pregnancy may reduce the incidence of neural tube defects such as spina bifida and anencephaly in the child.
Vitamin D3 - supports calcium absorption and is essential for building and maintaining healthy bones. Low vitamin D levels are common in women during pregnancy
Calcium and magnesium - are essential for bone health, as well as playing important roles in healthy muscle and nerve function.
Iron - is a component of haemoglobin, an essential component of red blood cells. Haemoglobin transports oxygen in the body. Having optimal haemoglobin levels helps the cells of the body receive sufficient oxygen. Without adequate iron levels the delivery of oxygen to cells decreases and energy production may suffer. Iron requirements increase during pregnancy because of increased needs for red blood cell formation and foetal growth.
Zinc - is essential to good health as it is involved in many enzymatic reactions in every cell of the body. Adequate levels of zinc are vital for a healthy baby's normal growth and development.
B group vitamins - play an essential role in baby's growth.

Dosage
Adults – Take 2 capsules a day with meals, or as professionally prescribed.

Contraindications and cautions
Do not exceed the stated dose of folic acid. If you have had a baby with a neural tube defect/spina bifida, you should seek specific medical advice.
Not to be taken with Blackmores Conceive Well™ Gold, Blackmores I-Folic®, Blackmores Folate, or other folic acid containing supplements.
Do not exceed the stated dose except on medical advice.
Not for the treatment of iron deficiency.
Always read the label. Use only as directed.

Additional information
Protein
Evidence suggests that protein-rich foods and diets may have a greater effect than high fat foods on our feelings of being satisfied and full after a meal. Feeling full can be important in the management of appetite and hunger.  Adequate dietary protein helps support a healthy musculoskeletal system which is important for maintaining healthy metabolism.
Fibre
Blackmores SuperFruit Smoothies contain a special blend of the fibres inulin and Luralean® .
LuraLean® is a proprietary concentrated soluble fibre from the roots of the plant Amorphophallus rivieri.  Soluble fibre forms a thickened gel when added to water. LuraLean® interacts with liquid in the stomach and mixes with the meal forming a thick gel.  This promotes a feeling of fullness at meal times and after eating which can reduce sensations of hunger. 
Inulin is a fibre and a prebiotic, which is not digested or absorbed.   Instead it is fermented in the digestive system, helping to promote the growth of friendly bacteria, such as Bifidobacteria, in the large intestine.
Low GI
The glycaemic index (GI) measures the differences in blood glucose levels after eating different foods. Foods with low GI are considered to be favourable in terms of health.  Low GI carbohydrate foods are digested and absorbed at a slow rate and can increase feelings of fullness and reduce hunger.  Conversely high GI meals have been associated with appetite stimulation and higher energy intake.
Concentrated superfruit extracts
Concentrated superfruit extracts are rich in polyphenol antioxidants. Polyphenols are a class of phytonutrients found in fruits and vegetables that have an antioxidant capacity.
Metabolism
A healthy metabolism requires nutrients such as the amino acid tyrosine and the mineral iodine, as well as vitamins B1, B2 and B3 which are required for the metabolism of fats, proteins, sugars and other carbohydrates.
Lean muscle mass is important for maintaining healthy metabolism. A diet high in quality protein, such as whey protein concentrate, helps maintain lean muscle mass.

Serving suggestion

Additional information
The human body does not manufacture its own vitamin C and so it must be sourced from our diet. Stress of all kinds, including ill health and emotional stress, increases the excretion of vitamin C from the body and may increase the need for this vitamin. If dietary intake is low, or the individual's need is particularly high, vitamin supplementation may be of benefit.
Vitamin C is involved in hundreds of biological processes. It is important in immunity as it is involved in the function of white blood cells and antibodies. It is also a vitally important antioxidant. It is beneficial when dealing with the symptoms of the common cold.
Vitamin C is involved in the manufacture of collagen, an important protein in the body. Collagen is a structural protein found in cartilage and tendons, and it helps to support blood vessels. Due to its role in collagen manufacture vitamin C is necessary for wound repair.

Dosage
Adults – Take 1 tablet 1 to 2 times a day with meals, or as professionally prescribed.
Children 4-12 years – We recommend Blackmores Bio C® Chewable 500mg.

Consult your healthcare professional before use if you have had renal calculi (kidney stones). Ascorbic acid may increase the risk of recurrence of calcium oxalate calculi
Always read the label. Use only as directed.

Features and benefits

No fishy aftertaste, developed without the use of artificial surfactants (polysorbates).
Vanilla-lemon flavouring masks any fishy odours.
Natural source of omega-3s.
Helps to reduce inflammation and joint swelling associated with arthritis.
Helps to support heart and cardiovascular health.
Helps to assist in the maintenance of normal eye and brain function.
Helps to decrease triglycerides (fat) in the blood of healthy people.
Mercury tested.

Additional information
Fish oil is a source of the omega-3 essential fatty acids. Essential fatty acids are incorporated into every cell membrane in the body, in the form of compounds called phospholipids. Cell membranes play the vital role of regulating what goes into, and what comes out of, each cell. The integrity and fluidity of the cell membrane is determined by the type of phospholipid that is available for the body to use. Cell membranes made up mainly of phospholipids derived from the essential polyunsaturated fatty acids are more fluid and function better than cell membranes made up of saturated fat or trans-fatty acids. A cell membrane working at optimal levels retains vital nutrients and electrolytes, has the ability to communicate with other cells and is responsive to hormones.
Omega-3 fatty acids are also important components of substances known as prostaglandins and leukotrienes. Prostaglandins and leukotrienes are important in immune function, smooth muscle function, platelet aggregation and inflammation. Fish oils have an anti-inflammatory action because prostaglandins and leukotrienes from omega-3 fatty acids have less inflammatory activity than prostaglandins and leukotrienes derived from other types of fatty acids.
Fish oils appear to alleviate the pain of rheumatoid arthritis due to the role of omega-3 fatty acids in suppression of the production of inflammatory compounds.
Fish oil inhibits triglyceride synthesis in the liver and so helps to lower fats (triglycerides) in the blood of healthy people, therefore supporting a healthy cardiovascular system.

Dosage
For arthritis:
Adults – Take up to 4 capsules 3 times a day with meals, or as professionally prescribed.
Children under 12 years – Only as professionally prescribed.
As an omega-3 supplement:
Adults – Take 2 capsules a day with a meal, or as professionally prescribed.
Children 6-12 years – Take 1 to 2 capsules a day (pierce and squeeze into milk, juice or cereal), or as professionally prescribed.
Children 2-6 years – Take 1 capsule a day (pierce and squeeze into milk, juice or cereal).

Contraindications and cautions
High doses of fish oil (10 or more capsules per day) may increase the risk of bleeding with blood-thinning medications and should not be taken in the week before surgery.
May occasionally cause mild reflux.

Total 1 g (1000 mg)

Product.description:
Homeopathic Product

Indications: Temporary relief of strains, sprains, bruising, and sore, aching muscles. Arnica is useful for the relief of muscular pain caused by over-exertion, heavy work or sporting activities.

Directions
Adults: 4 sprays.
Children 2 - 12 years: 2 sprays

Initially spray under the tongue every half hour for 4 doses. Thereafter, every 4 hours until symptoms abate.

If symptoms persist consult your healthcare professional.

Features and benefits

Replenish nutrients important for the body’s response to stress
Traditionally used for emotional exhaustion when stressed
Helps support healthy functioning of the nervous system
Traditionally support the body’s ability to cope in times of stress
May help relieve premenstrual symptoms
Provides antioxidants which assist in protecting cells from free radical damage and oxidative stress
 
Additional information
Stress, particularly prolonged stress, places a big load on your body, especially your nervous system and adrenal glands.
Adrenal glands secrete adrenaline and other stress-related hormones in response to mental and emotional stress. These hormones cause an increase in heart and breathing rates, more blood being supplied to the muscles and brain, reduced production of digestive secretions and increased blood sugar levels. Constant and long-term stress can result in the adrenal glands becoming ‘exhausted' leaving the individual tired and ‘stressed out'.
Withania has traditionally been used as a balancing herb for the nervous system. It can help to deal with the symptoms of nervous exhaustion which can result from stress and overactivity, as it has a calming and relaxing effect. Withania has also traditionally been used as a tonic for the libido. It contains choline, a nutrient that is important for memory and learning function.
Vitamin C, vitamin B5, vitamin B6, zinc and magnesium are nutrients necessary for the production of adrenal hormones. During times of stress the body's need for these nutrients may increase.
B vitamins are necessary for nervous system health and the nervous system has an increased requirement for them during times of stress. The vitamin B group are water soluble vitamins that are not stored by the body in large amounts therefore regular consumption of these vitamins in the diet is necessary.
Magnesium and vitamin B6 may assist with mood imbalances associated with the menstrual cycle.
Zinc levels can be decreased during times of stress. Zinc is an important antioxidant and is required for the detoxification of chemicals including alcohol

Dosage
Adults – Take 1 tablet twice a day with a meal, or as professionally prescribed.

Contraindications and cautions
Not recommended for use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

Active ingredients
Vitamin B1 (Thiamine nitrate) 12.5mg
Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin) 12.5mg
Nicotinamide 25mg
Vitamin B5 (Pantothenic acid from calcium pantothenate 37.5mg) 33.7mg
Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine hydrochloride) 25mg
Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin) 25µg
Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid) 75mg
Vitamin H (Biotin) 37.5µg
Folic acid 150µg
Magnesium oxide - heavy (Magnesium 62.5mg) 109mg
Zinc amino acid chelate (Zinc 6mg) 30mg
Withania somnifera (Winter cherry) extract equiv. to dry root 1.5g (1500mg)

Medicine interactions
Magnesium and zinc may decrease absorption and efficacy of some medications. If taking tetracycline or quinolone antibiotics separate doses by at least 2 hours.

Folic acid may decrease the effectiveness of methotrexate in the treatment of leukaemia.

Physical description
An opaque light pink, oblong shaped unprinted tablet.

Nervatona Calm contains ingredients traditionally used in homeopathic medicine to help relieve stress, mild anxiety, restlessness and insomnia. It may thereby help you to relax and unwind, so you can cope better with the effects of stress and mild anxiety such as tension, irritability, restlessness and insomnia.

Helpful hints
•Stress is often difficult to avoid - how you handle it is usually what makes the difference.
•The best way to minimise the effects of stress is to start taking good care of yourself
•Aim for 8 hours a night of deep, relaxing sleep
•Enjoy some regular physical activity to release natural feel - good chemicals in your body
•Eat small meals that contain plenty of complex carbohydrate up to 6 times a day to help keep blood sugar levels stable
•Cut down on stimulants like coffee and alcohol
•Find a relaxation method that you really enjoy and works for you - it may be yoga, meditation, deep breathing, bush walking or any number of things.
•Nervatona Calm is generally better to use if relaxation is required after work in preparation for retiring (sleeping).

Dosage

Adults: 4 sprays.
Children 6 to 12 years: 2 sprays. Initially, spray under the tongue every half hour for 4 doses. Thereafter, 4 hourly until symptoms abate. If symptoms persist consult your healthcare practitioner.

Active Ingredients - Oral Spray

Each 1 mL contains:
Cocculus (Indian cockle) 4X, 50 mcL; Helonias (False unicorn root) 4X, 50 mcL; Ignatia (St Ignatius bean) 4X, 50 mcL; Nux vom. (Poison nut) 6C, 1.67 mcL; Passiflora (Passion flower) 1X, 50 mcL; Phosphoricum acidum (Phosphoric acid) 5X, 60 mcL; Sepia (Cuttlefish ink) 4X, 50 mcL; Zincum met. (Zinc) 10X, 5 mcL.

Homeopathic ingredients traditionally used for the above indications.

Contains ingredients traditionally used in homeopathic medicine for the relief of sleeplessness and insomnia, particularly associated with mental overactivity or anxiety.

Helpful hints
•Try and work out why you aren't sleeping - which sound's obvious enough but isn't always easy. If you can remove the cause or find new ways to deal with the cause, you'll be well on the way to sleeping better.
•Getting some regular physical activity is one of the keys to managing stress and sleeping better. Mid afternoon or early evening is the best time to exercise when you have sleep problems.
•Create a bed time routine that gently prepares you for bed each night. Spend the last half to one hour of your evening winding down your body and mind. Listen to soothing music, read something light, have a warm milk drink and a light snack (like a piece of toast).
•Cut down on stimulants like tea, coffee, alcohol and certain medicines after about 4 PM. Avoid large, rich or salty meals late at night.
•Learn new relaxation techniques that work for you.

Dosage

Adults: 2 tablets. Children 6 to 12 years: 1 tablet. Dissolve under the tongue half an hour before bed and then immediately before going to bed. Use 1 dose every half hour for up to 4 doses if you wake and wish to go back to sleep. If symptoms persist consult your healthcare practitioner.

Additional Advice

All stimulating activities such as television or eating etc should be avoided for a minimum of 1 hour prior to retiring, and a regular sleeping routine should be adhered to. Failure of this condition to respond to treatment should prompt investigations to determine underlying aetiological factors such as depression or other emotional disturbances.

Active Ingredients - Tablets

Each glucose tablet is medicated with 278 mcg of each of: Capsicum (Cayenne pepper) 14C, Chamomilla (German chamomile) 3C, Coffea (Coffee) 4C, Coffea (Coffee) 30C, Gelsemium (Yellow jasmine) 4C, Humulus (Hops) 3C, Hyoscyamus (Henbane) 6C, Passiflora (Passion flower) 3C, Valeriana (Valerian root) 3C.

Homeopathic ingredients traditionally used for the above indications.

Contains ingredients traditionally used in homeopathic medicine for the relief of sleeplessness and insomnia, particularly associated with mental overactivity or anxiety.

Helpful hints
•Try and work out why you aren't sleeping - which sound's obvious enough but isn't always easy. If you can remove the cause or find new ways to deal with the cause, you'll be well on the way to sleeping better.
•Getting some regular physical activity is one of the keys to managing stress and sleeping better. Mid afternoon or early evening is the best time to exercise when you have sleep problems.
•Create a bed time routine that gently prepares you for bed each night. Spend the last half to one hour of your evening winding down your body and mind. Listen to soothing music, read something light, have a warm milk drink and a light snack (like a piece of toast).
•Cut down on stimulants like tea, coffee, alcohol and certain medicines after about 4 PM. Avoid large, rich or salty meals late at night.
•Learn new relaxation techniques that work for you.

Dosage

Adults: 4 sprays. Children 2 to 12 years: 2 sprays. Spray under the tongue half an hour before bed and then immediately before going to bed. Use 1 dose every half hour for up to 4 doses if you wake and wish to go back to sleep. If symptoms persist consult your healthcare practitioner.

Additional Advice

All stimulating activities such as television or eating etc should be avoided for a minimum of 1 hour prior to retiring, and a regular sleeping routine should be adhered to. Failure of this condition to respond to treatment should prompt investigations to determine underlying aetiological factors such as depression or other emotional disturbances.

Active Ingredients - Oral Spray

Capsicum (Cayenne pepper) 14C, Chamomilla (German chamomile) 3C, Coffea (Coffee) 4C, Coffea (Coffee) 30C, Gelsemium (Yellow jasmine) 4C, Humulus (Hops) 3C, Hyoscyamus (Henbane) 6C, Passiflora (Passion flower) 3C, Valeriana (Valerian root) 3C.

Homeopathic ingredients traditionally used for the above indications.

Product.description:
Scientifically formulated for young babies by infant nutrition experts.

As well as providing essential nutrients needed for growth and development, this nutritionally balanced premium infant formula features Digesti Plus®, a unique blend of ingredients that helps support healthy digestion.

Suitable for bottle-fed babies from birth and when changing from breastfeeding.

Allergen/ Dietary requirements:
  • Egg Free  
  • Gluten Free  
  • Peanut Free  
  • Sesame Free  
  • Wheat Free  
  • Iron Enriched  
  • Source of Calcium

Ingrdients:
Lactose, Vegetable Oils (Sunflower, Coconut, Soy), Skim Milk, Whey Protein (Enriched with Alpha-lactalbumin), Prebiotics (Galacto-oligosaccharides), Minerals (Calcium Phosphate, Sodium Citrate, Magnesium Chloride, Potassium Chloride, Ferrous Sulphate, Zinc Sulphate, Copper Sulphate, Manganese Sulphate, Potassium Iodide, Sodium Selenite), Vitamins (Vitamin C, Choline, Niacinamide, Calcium Pantothenate, Vitamin A Palmitate, Vitamin B12, Vitamin E Acetate, Riboflavin (Vitamin B2), Vitamin D3, Thiamine Hydrochloride (Vitamin B1), Vitamin B6, Folic Acid, Vitamin K1, d-Biotin), Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin), ARA (Omega-6) from M.alpina, Refined Tuna Oil containing DHA (Omega-3), Probiotic (Bifidobacterium lactis (BB-12)), Inositol, Taurine, Nucleotides (Cytidine-5'-monophosphate, Uridine-5'-monophosphate, Adenosine-5'-monophosphate, Inosine-5'-monophosphate, Guanosine-5'-monphosphate), L-carnitine.

Heinz® Nurture Gold® Infant Formula 1 is made from a premium formulation of ingredients and is the only infant formula in Australia* with both pre and probiotics to support healthy digestion.

*Based on the H.J. Heinz Company Australia Ltd review of infant formula products on the market in Australia as at January 2013. All information on products not manufactured by Heinz was obtained from published information by that manufacturer, including the pack label and website.

Key Heinz Nurture Gold Infant Formula 1 Ingredients Explained:
Prebiotic Galacto-oligosaccharide (GOS)
The prebiotic GOS is a non-digestible carbohydrate that can promote the growth of the beneficial probiotic bacteria in the digestive system by providing them with nourishment.
Omega 3  DHA
Omega 3 DHA (Docosahexanoic Acid) is a LCP (long chain polyunsaturated fatty acid) from fish oil that may assist brain and eye development.
Nucleotides
Nucleotides have different functions including helping to develop a healthy immune system, as well as overall growth and development. 
Iron
Iron is an essential mineral important for healthy growth and brain development. 
Probiotic  Bifidus
Probiotics are  the friendly bacterial cultures  which encourage healthy digestion and may assist the body’s natural defences. 

Important: Breastfeeding is best for babies. Maternal nutrition requirements increase during breastfeeding. Before introducing infant formula, always seek professional advice, as once bottle feeding has been commenced it is difficult to reverse the decision. Partial bottle feeding may also adversely affect breastfeeding. Always use infant formula as directed because improper use can affect the health of the infant. Always consider the social and financial implications before selecting a method of infant feeding.

Usage
Infant gripes in the tummy, colic, wind, minor tummy upsets. When Baby experiences those low down gripes .

Hartley’s  Gripe Water is a natural blend of herbal ingredients of which the base ingredient Dill Oil has been used safely in commercial infant preparations for more than 100years.

Composition
Dill Seed Oil - Anethum graveolens (herb)
3,000 years of recorded use and modern day research supports the use of Dill as a digestive aid, listed also in the British Pharmacopoeia for use by formulating retail pharmacists since the early 1900's. The herb relaxes the muscles of the digestive tract and studies show that it helps prevent the formation of intestinal gas bubbles. Also is known as an infection fighter, settling and emptying the lower bowel area whilst inhibiting the growth of bacteria that attack the intestinal tract.

FilipendulaUlmira (Meadowsweet) extract Equiv dry herb

Meadowsweet - Filipendula ulmira (herb) Neutralises excess stomach acid: anti - inflammatory action: antacid action and known for its urinary antiseptic quality.

Other ingredients contained in the product as excipients
An excipient is generally a  substance used as a carrier for the active ingredients of a medication. Also used to stabilize the active ingredient, excipients are added, ensuring that the active ingredient stays "active", and, just as importantly, stable for a sufficiently long period of time that the shelf-life of the product makes it competitive with other products.

Coriander Oil - Coriandrum sativum (herb) use as a calmative to relieve flatulence: stomach ache and nausea and in Ayurvedic medicine for urinary tract infection : reduces muscle tension and spasm.

Peppermint Oil - Mentha piperita (herb) the most widely used herb in the western world …reduces muscle tension and spasm: relieves wind and colic: suppresses nausea and vomiting. Given to calm digestive problems, irritable bowel syndrome, colic & flatulence.

Fennel Oil - foeniculum vulgare (herb) relieves wind: stimulates the stomach: Chinese medicine, prescribes Fennel Oil for abdominal pain and indigestion.Contraindications

  • Hypersensitivity to any ingredient, Australian Therapeutic Goods Department (TGA) list the main ingredient Dill as safe to use for infants, if minor upsets occur from using the preparation reduce the dosage.
  • If gripe symptoms continue consult your health care professional.
  • Does not contain artificial sweeteners
  • Note: the inclusion of a small amount of ethanol assists in the suspension of active ingredients and as a preservative. It does not have any 'active quality' in the product.

Dosage and Administration

  • Not more than 6 doses in 24 hours
  • Newborn infants 5 – 10 drops from a medical dropper
  • 1-6 months 2.5 5ml
  • 6-24 months 5- 10ml
  • Children over 2 years 10-15ml
  • Mix with cooled boiled water
  • Give slowly by spoon OR with a little water in a bottle. Best taken after meals
  • Can be mixed with juice or formula.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION

BENEFITS OF GLUCOSAMINE
  • High strength, once daily dose.
  • Effective for relieving stiff, tender or aching joints from arthritis or sports injuries.
  • Helps slow joint damage in osteoarthritis.
  • Helps reduce cartilage wear.
  • Maintains healthy tendons and ligaments.
 
HOW IT WORKS
Glucosamine is a substance that occurs naturally in joint cartilage, the tissue that is damaged in osteoarthritis or through injury. Taking Glucosamine Hydrochloride has been shown to be as effective as some medications for the relief of symptoms associated with osteoarthritis. Glucosamine is a key part of the structure of cartilage, which is essential for proper joint function. As one ages, cartilage becomes more susceptible to breakdown and damage, which may result in the symptoms of osteoarthritis.
 
Glucosamine maintains joint mobility and flexibility and plays an important role in the production of collagen, the natural cushion found in cartilage which may slow the progression of osteoarthritis. Glucosamine can also help to reduce joint pain, inflammation and swelling in those suffering from arthritis and sports injuries.

Product.product_title: 30 Plus (Thirty Plus) Essential Health for Women 60 Tablets
Product.description:
30 PLUS® NuWoman® is a scientifically formulated natural supplement made especially for women to assist in the relief of symptoms associated with hormonal fluctuations and imbalances associated with pre-menstrual tension (PMT).

Although the formulation is called 30 PLUS® NuWoman® hormonal imbalances associated with PMT can occur in younger women, even teenagers.

The imbalances associated with PMT can be exacerbated by various things, such as a woman’s body readjusting after childbirth; as a result of prescription hormone medications; as well as diet and monthly hormonal changes.

The 30 PLUS® NuWoman® formulation contains an extract of the flowering shrub Cimicifuga racemosa, natural amino acids, nutrients and vitamins to provide relief for women who are experiencing symptoms associated with hormonal fluctuations or imbalances associated with PMT.

Mild anxiety

Irritability

Stress

Nervous tension

Mood changes

Emotional instability

Tiredness

Difficulty concentrating


Ingredients

30 PLUS® NuWoman®  - formula explained

The 30 PLUS® NuWoman® formula combines an extract of the clinically researched flowering shrub Cimicifuga racemosa combined with natural amino acids, nutrients and vitamins intended to assist in the relief of the symptoms of pre-menstrual tension (PMT).

Cimicifuga racemosa (extract)

Cimicifuga racemosa has been scientifically and clinically researched for the plant's potential to provide relief for women who are experiencing symptoms associated with PMT, peri-menopause and menopause. Extracts of Cimicifuga racemosa come in many different qualities and potencies, all of which affects the therapeutic properties of the finished product. The Cimicifuga racemosa extract used in 30 PLUS® NuWoman® has been standardised to a level acknowledged by German research and shown in clinical studies to be a consistent and effective form of the extract. 30 PLUS® NuWoman® contains 60 mg of Cimicifuga extract in each tablet.

Chromium picolinate

Chromium is an essential nutrient for the maintenance of hormone and blood sugar regulation. 30 PLUS® NuWoman® contains 200 mcg of chromium picolinate in each tablet.

Tyrosine

Tyrosine is an essential amino acid, which performs several functions that may benefit women who are experiencing symptoms related to hormonal fluctuations or imbalances associated with PMT. Tyrosine is a precursor to natural brain transmitters called endorphins. Endorphins are the chemical substances that make us feel good. Tyrosine may assist in the symptomatic relief of mood changes referred to as mood swings, irritability, emotional instability, mild anxiety and nervous tension. During times of prolonged stress our adrenal glands may become fatigued. As a result, a feeling of tiredness may be experienced. Tyrosine is an essential nutrient for the adrenals and may be beneficial during times of stress. 30 PLUS® NuWoman® contains 150 mg of Tyrosine in each tablet.

Vitamin B6 - pyridoxine hydrochloride

Research has been conducted into the ability of vitamin B6 to play a role in the relief of the symptoms associated with PMT. 30 PLUS® NuWoman® contains 50 mg of vitamin B6 in each tablet.

Vitamin B9 - folic acid 

Folic acid is necessary for the correct synthesis of hormones. If the body does not synthesise its hormones correctly, an imbalance may occur. A complex pathway of hormone synthesis exists within the body and without adequate levels of folic acid the body may not be able to manufacture the correct levels of the hormones that it needs. 30 PLUS® NuWoman® contains 99 mcg of folic acid in each tablet.

Vitamin B12 - cyanocobalamin

Vitamin B12 is necessary for the correct detoxification of hormones. Along with B6 and folic acid, vitamin B12 assists the body to break down hormones properly so that a natural balance is maintained. 30 PLUS® NuWoman® contains 25 mcg of vitamin B12 in each tablet.

Each tablet contains the active ingredients:

Cimicifuga racemosa rhizome extract dry concentrate standardised (6.5:1) in 50% E:W 60 mg, equivalent to Cimicifuga racemosa rhizome 390mg, equivalent triterpene glycosides calculated 27-desoxyactein (of Cimicifuga racemosa standardised) 1.65 mg; calcium hydrogen phosphate 24.23 mg, equivalent calcium 5.64 mg; chromium picolinate 200 micrograms , equivalent chromium 24.86 micrograms; cycanocobalamin (B12) 25 micrograms; folic acid (B9) 99 micrograms; pyridoxine hydrochloride (B6) 25.77 mg, equivalent pyridoxine 20.57 mg; tyrosine 150 mg.

Recommended dosage:

Two tablets per day. One in the morning and one in the evening, or as prescribed by a health-care professional, taken preferably with meals. 30 PLUS® NuWoman® should be taken for a minimum of two menstrual cycles before its effectiveness is assessed.

Does not contain added starch, gluten, yeast, lactose, salt, or artificial colouring. Always read the label. Use only as directed. If symptoms persist consult your health-care practitioner. Vitamins may only be of assistance if the dietary vitamin intake is inadequate.

Store at a temperature of less than 30° centigrade. Do not use this product if the blister foil is broken.

PRECAUTION: On rare occasions gastro-intestinal upset or hypersensitivity (rash or irritation) may be experienced. If you are pregnant or breast feeding, it is good health-care practice to not take any supplements without the advice of a health-care professional.

Warning: In very rare cases, black cohosh has been associated with liver failure. If you are experiencing yellowing of the skin or whites of the eyes, dark urine, nausea, vomiting, unusual tiredness, weakness, stomach or abdominal pain, and/or loss of appetite, you should stop using this product and see your doctor.

Product.product_title: A&D Infra Red Digital Ear Thermometer
Product.description:
General Information

The UT-202 Infra-red ear thermometer by A&DMedical, makes taking anyone's temperature quick, easy and safe.

The UT-202 is a compact pen style earthermometer and measures anyone's temperature from infants to the elderly. TheUT-202 automatically stores the last reading in memory and a result is shown inas little as 1 second. it has a long battery life, comes with a multi-lingualinstruction manual and hard shell carry case for easy storage.

The UT-202 ear thermometer has a waterproof tip,so you no longer need to worry about buying little probe covers- simply cleanthe tip with rubbing alcohol or warm water. The UT-202 Infra red earthermometer is also covered by a 1-year warranty.

Features and benefits

Effective for osteoarthritic pain relief
Helps reduce cartilage wear
Contains the most scientifically validated form of glucosamine; glucosamine sulfate sodium chloride complex
Results expected after 2-4 weeks

Additional information
Glucosamine and sulfate are natural components found in the cartilage matrix and synovial fluid.  Glucosamine is a major building block of the substances that together with protein form the structural units in cartilage. These structural units, called aggrecans, are important for the elasticity, resilience and shock-absorbing properties of cartilage. Ageing decreases the body’s ability to restore and manufacture normal cartilage. Supplementary glucosamine sulfate as glucosamine sulfate sodium chloride complex helps reduce cartilage wear, increase joint mobility and decrease joint stiffness in osteoarthritis.
Osteoarthritis is characterized by joint degeneration and loss of cartilage. As we get older the ‘wear and tear’ effects of use cause degenerative changes in the cartilage. The cartilage becomes more susceptible to breakdown and damage, which may result in the typical symptoms of osteoarthritis. These symptoms include decreased mobility, increased joint stiffness, and pain.
Glucosamine may help to provide relief from these symptoms, as well as helping to reduce cartilage wear and provide temporary relief of the pain associated with this condition.
Clinical trials have shown that 1500 mg glucosamine sulfate significantly improves pain and functionality in osteoarthritis. Results show a decrease in pain of 20-41%, and improved functionality of 28-41%. In addition, glucosamine sulfate may have a long-term protective effect, acting to reduce cartilage wear. An eight-year study on 275 patients, published in 2008, found that supplementation with 1500 mg/day of glucosamine sulfate for at least one year reduced the risk of knee replacement to approximately half that of the placebo group. A pharmaueconomic sub-group analysis of the same study found that patients who had previously taken glucosamine sulfate used significantly less medications & health resources for osteoarthritis symptoms.

Dosage
Adults – Take 2 easy swallow tablets once a day with a meal or as professionally prescribed.
Children under 12 years – Only as professionally prescribed.

Contraindications and cautions
Glucosamine is derived from seafood. Not recommended for people with seafood allergies.
Contains approximately 166 mg sodium per daily dose

Active ingredients
Glucosamine sulfate sodium chloride complex
Equivalent to glucosamine sulfate 750 mg  1 g (1000 mg)

Medicine interactions
Consult your healthcare professional before use if taking warfarin.

Physical description
White, vanilla flavoured tablet with easy-to-swallow coating.

Tears Naturale Free® is preservative-free. If your eye doctor has recommended a preservative-free product, then Tears Naturale Free® would be an excellent choice:
•Tears Naturale Free® gives you more artificial tears solution per vial than other brands

Dry eye is a term used to describe a group of different diseases and conditions that result from inadequate wetting and lubrication of the eye.

Although millions of people experience it, dry eye is not always easy to diagnose; it can easily be mistaken for other conditions such as infections or allergies.

Believe it or not, excessive tearing caused by crying, cold weather, etc., can actually cause dry eye symptoms.

There are many different abnormalities that can cause dry eye, such as decreased tear production, excessive evaporation, blinking problems, etc. Many medications, such as antihistamines, can also contribute to dry eye

There is no known "cure" for dry eye. However, in most cases, dry eye can be treated with an artificial tear solution or, in more severe cases, by blocking the puncta. Whatever the treatment mode chosen, effective treatment of dry eye must either replace or enhance natural tears.

Applying rewetting drops

To replace natural tears, an artificial tear solution can be effective. Artificial tears are available with and without preservatives. Preservative-free artificial tears are recommended for people who can't tolerate preservatives or who must use these solutions many times per day.

If artificial tears are needed on more than an occasional basis, the type of preservative used is an important consideration. Many artificial tear solutions contain benzalkonium chloride (BAC), a preservative that with frequent use can actually damage the epithelium and lead to further problems. A better choice is a solution with Polyquad® preservative, so gentle that even people with the most sensitive eyes can use it.

To enhance natural tears, a more advanced artificial tear is required. Such solutions would include artificial tears with formulations containing zinc and bicarbonate, substances that can actually contribute to the growth and maintenance of healthy mucin, tear film, and epithelium. Often, overnight protection is needed. In these cases a more viscous preparation should be used, one that is designed to provide long-lasting protection and lubrication.

Product Description

Features and benefits

Natural source of omega-3.
  • Helps to reduce inflammation and joint swelling associated with arthritis.
  • Helps to support heart and cardiovascular health.
  • Helps to assist in the maintenance of normal eye and brain function.
  • Helps to decrease triglycerides (fat) in the blood of healthy people.
  • Mercury tested.
  • Surfactant free.

Additional information
Fish oil is a source of the omega-3 essential fatty acids. Essential fatty acids are incorporated into every cell membrane in the body, in the form of compounds called phospholipids. Cell membranes play the vital role of regulating what goes into, and what comes out of each cell. The integrity and fluidity of the cell membrane is determined by the type of phospholipid that is available for the body to use. Cell membranes made up mainly of phospholipids derived from the essential polyunsaturated fatty acids are more fluid and function better than cell membranes made up of saturated fat or trans fatty acids. A cell membrane working at optimal levels retains vital nutrients and electrolytes, has the ability to communicate with other cells and is responsive to hormones.

Omega-3 fatty acids are also important components of substances known as prostaglandins and leukotrienes. Prostaglandins and leukotrienes are important in immune function, smooth muscle function, platelet aggregation and inflammation. Fish oils have an anti-inflammatory action because prostaglandins and leukotrienes from omega-3 fatty acids have less inflammatory activity than prostaglandins and leukotrienes derived from other types of fatty acids.

Fish oils appear to alleviate the pain of rheumatoid arthritis due to the role of omega-3 fatty acids in suppression of the production of inflammatory compounds.
Fish oil inhibits triglyceride synthesis in the liver and so helps to lower fats (triglycerides) in blood, therefore supporting a healthy cardiovascular system.

Dosage
As an omega-3 supplement:
Adults - Take 2 capsules a day with a meal, or as professionally prescribed.
Children 2-12 years - Take 1 capsule a day (pierce and squeeze into milk, juice or cereal), or as professionally prescribed.
For joint inflammation:
Adults - Take up to 4 capsules 3 times a day with meals, or as professionally prescribed.
Children under 12 years - Only as professionally prescribed.

Contraindications and cautions
High doses of fish oil (10 or more capsules per day) may increase the risk of bleeding with blood-thinning medications and should not be taken in the week before surgery

Active ingredients
Fish oil (Natural)
containing omega-3 marine triglycerides 300 mg as: 1g (1000mg)
Eicosapentaenoic Acid (EPA) 180mg
Docosahexaenoic Acid (DHA) 120mg

FEATURES AND BENEFITS
Contains citrus bioflavonoids extract to help boost its action in the body.
Buffered with mineral ascorbates making it gentle on the stomach.
  • Contains vitamin C and natural sources of rosehips and acerola
  • Reduces the severity and duration of colds.
  • Helps to support skin suppleness and elasticity via its role in collagen production.
  • Is an antioxidant, which helps protect against free radical damage.
  • Promotes wound healing.
  • Maintains capillary health.

Additional information
The human body does not manufacture its own vitamin C and so it must be sourced from our diet. Stress of all kinds, including ill health and emotional stress, increases the excretion of vitamin C from the body and may increase the need for this vitamin. If dietary intake is low or an individual's need is particularly high, vitamin supplementation may be of benefit.
Vitamin C is involved in hundreds of biological processes. It is important in immunity as it is involved in the function of white blood cells and antibodies. It is beneficial when dealing with the symptoms of the common cold.
Vitamin C is involved in the manufacture of collagen, an important protein in the body. Collagen is a structural protein found in cartilage and tendons, and it helps to support blood vessels. Due to its role in collagen manufacture vitamin C is necessary for wound repair.
Citrus bioflavonoids have been shown to support capillary function by reducing fragility of capillary walls and improving capillary permeability.

Dosage
Adults – Take 1 tablet a day with a meal, or as professionally prescribed. At the onset of cold symptoms the dose may be increased to 3 tablets a day.
Children 4-12 years – We recommend Blackmores Bio C® Chewable.
Not to be used by children under 4 years of age without medical advice.
Contraindications and cautions
If symptoms persist, see your healthcare professional.
Consult your healthcare professional before use if you have had renal calculi (kidney stones). Ascorbic acid may increase the risk of recurrence of calcium oxalate calculi.
Always read the label. Use only as directed.

Active ingredients
Ascorbic acid 400 mg
Sodium ascorbate 350 mg
Calcium ascorbate (equiv. to vitamin C 1000mg) 400 mg
Total vitamin C 1000 mg Citrus bioflavonoids extract 25 mg
Rutin 50 mg
Hesperidin 50 mg
Rosa canina (Rosehips) extract equiv. to dry fruit 250 mg
Malpighia punicifolia (Acerola) extract equiv. to dry fruit 50 mg

Medicine interactions
Ascorbic acid may increase the absorption of aluminium. In kidney failure doses should be separated by at least 2 hours from doses of aluminium-containing preparations.
If taking propranolol, separate doses by at least two hours. Ascorbic acid may decrease the absorption and efficacy of this medication.

General Information
Auralgan Ear Drops offer you effective relief of symptoms through its three-way action.

Benzocaine, a local anaesthetic provides pain relief while phenazone reduces the painful inflammation. Glycerol absorbs moisture from exposed and inflamed areas relieving pressure in the middle ear. Also assists in the softening of wax for easier removal.
Warnings
Auralgan is not recommended for use in patients with a perforated eardrum and should be discontinued if irritation occurs. Do not use if hypersensitivity has occurred with previous use of any of the ingredients or similar substances.
Ingredients
Each mL Contains: Phenazone 54mg, Benzocaine 14mg, Glycerol q.s. to 1mL.


Also contains as preservative: Hydroxyquinoline Sulphate 375mcg/mL.

Directions
Use Auralgan eardrops at room temperature. If bottle is cold to the touch, warm in hand for a minute.


Otitis Media and Swimmers's Ear: Tilt head to one side with affected ear uppermost, fill ear canal, and plug ear with cotton wool previously moistened with Auralgan. Avoid touching the ear with dropper. Repeat every 1 to 2 hours until pain and congestion are relieved. If condition persists, please conult your doctor.


Removal of Wax Fill ear canal with Auralgan. Plug ear with cotton previously moistened with Auralgan. Do this 3 times daily for 2 to 3 days to help detach wax from ear.

Features and benefits
One tablet contains the recommended daily intake (RDI) for magnesium.
Combines magnesium with co-factors for improved absorption and utilisation.

Additional information

Magnesium is essential for many cellular functions, particularly for the normal functioning of muscle and nerve tissue. Signs of low magnesium levels can include fatigue, mental confusion, irritability, muscle cramps, problems with nerve conduction and muscle contraction and predisposition to stress.
 
If the blood is low in magnesium it takes it from the muscles and without enough magnesium in muscles they stiffen up or contract. The result may be painful cramps, irritability, twitching or even tremors.  Sufficient magnesium helps all muscles in the body to function optimally.
 
The other nutrients present in Bio Magnesium assist with the utilisation of magnesium in the body.  Vitamin B6 is an important co-factor, working with magnesium in many enzyme systems in the body.   Studies have shown that combining B6 and magnesium can help to reduce PMS symptoms.

Dosage

Adults – Take 1 tablet a day with a meal, or as professionally prescribed.

Children 6 - 12 years – We recommend Blackmores Magnesium Compound.

Children (under 6 years) – Only as professionally prescribed.

WARNING - This product contains Pyridoxine hydrochloride which may be dangerous when used in large amounts or for a long time.
Pyridoxine-induced peripheral neuropathy is most commonly reported with doses of 1 g or more daily, taken for 2 months to 3 years
If symptoms persist, see your healthcare professional.
